app.diagnostics: Technical reports: {n} (details in the browser console)
app.help.alert: An in-page message (info, success, error), optionally formatted with Markdown.
app.help.alert.title: Alert
app.help.border: A container with north, south, west, east and center regions (each component names its own with `region`), like a desktop application layout; the sides can be resized. Below 768px the regions stack.
app.help.border.title: Border
app.help.box: A layout container that arranges components in a row or a column, with gap, alignment and wrapping.
app.help.box.title: Box
app.help.button: Runs a sequence of steps (`onClick`): call a data source, update the state, ask for confirmation, open a dialog, navigate, show a message. With `run` it calls a named sequence of the screen.
app.help.button.title: Button
app.help.calendar: A monthly calendar with events read from a data source, per-day counters and a maximum of visible events; clicking an event can run steps (`onSelect`, the event is in `row`).
app.help.calendar.title: Calendar
app.help.chart: A bar, line or pie chart with data from a data source: you name the category field and the value fields.
app.help.chart.title: Chart
app.help.dataTable: A table with per-column filters, sorting and grouping computed in the page, over all the rows received.
app.help.dataTable.title: Data table
app.help.detail: A read-only card with label and value pairs read from a data source; a field with `format: markdown` is shown formatted, and each field can have a tooltip.
app.help.detail.title: Detail
app.help.filterBar: A bar of fields that writes into the screen state (`bind`); tables and data sources read the filters through expressions and refresh by themselves.
app.help.filterBar.title: Filters
app.help.form: Fields with validation, conditional fields, column grid and repeatable rows. Submitting (`onSubmit`) runs a sequence of steps with the form values in `form`.
app.help.form.title: Form
app.help.grid: A column layout container: components span one or more columns and wrap; on narrow screens the columns shrink.
app.help.grid.title: Grid
app.help.image: An image from a relative or https address, always with alternative text (`alt`) for those who cannot see it; optional size.
app.help.image.title: Image
app.help.input: A stand-alone field, outside a form, that writes into the screen state (`bind`): text, number, date, select, switch and the other field types.
app.help.input.title: Input
app.help.kanban: Cards in columns by status; moving a card (also with the keyboard) runs steps, for example the call that saves the new status.
app.help.kanban.title: Kanban
app.help.link: A link to a screen of the application (with its parameters) or to an external https address.
app.help.link.title: Link
app.help.progress: A progress bar or circle (`kind: circle`) with value, maximum, label and tone (neutral, primary, success, danger).
app.help.progress.title: Progress
app.help.section: A card with a title that groups other components, stacked or side by side (`layout: row`). The simplest way to split a screen into parts.
app.help.section.title: Section
app.help.serverDataTable: Like the data table, but filters, sorting, groups, totals and pages are computed by the service: suited to large data sets.
app.help.serverDataTable.title: Server data table
app.help.stats: Numeric indicators (KPIs) with label, format and tone, read from a data source or computed with expressions.
app.help.stats.title: Stats
app.help.table: Rows from a data source with server-side paging, cell formats, sorting, selection with bulk actions, row action menu, expandable rows, clickable cells and a totals row.
app.help.table.title: Table
app.help.tabs: Several tabs, each with its own title and components; one is visible at a time.
app.help.tabs.title: Tabs
app.help.text: Plain text (line breaks are kept), heading (`style: heading`) or Markdown formatted text (`format: markdown`: bold, lists, tables, links). The text can contain expressions and translations.
app.help.text.title: Text
app.help.timeline: Events in date order, read from a data source, with title, description and tone.
app.help.timeline.title: Timeline
app.help.tree: A tree view of nested items from a data source; selecting a node can run steps (`onSelect`).
app.help.tree.title: Tree
app.help.wizard: A step-by-step procedure (2 to 10 steps): each step has a label, a description and its own components; “Next” can be enabled only when the step data is fine (`nextIf`). The current step can be bound to the state (`bind`).
app.help.wizard.title: Wizard
app.permissions: {n, plural, =0 {no permissions} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
app.showcase.common: Every component also has id, visibleIf, hiddenIf, enabledIf, readOnlyIf and tooltip. The full reference is in docs/riferimento-schema.md.
app.signedOutText: You have signed out. In production you would return to the identity provider here.
app.title: KinetiX · demo
fattura_nuova.l_importo_deve_essere_magg: The amount must be greater than zero
fatture.elenco_delle_fatture_con_filtro: List of invoices with a status filter and sending of drafts.
ordini_elenco.ordini_con_azioni_di_riga_: Orders with row actions according to permissions.
vetrina.lingue.importo: Amount formatted in the active language: {v}
vetrina.lingue.intro: Change the language from the selector at the top: the texts in this section come from a catalogue per language.
vetrina.lingue.righe: {n, plural, =0 {No presses recorded} one {# press recorded} other {# presses recorded}}
vetrina.lingue.tooltip: This tooltip changes with the language
vetrina_attivita.descrizione: Kanban with movable cards, event timeline, progress bars, images and links.
vetrina_attivita.kanban: Kanban: drag a card or use “Move to”
vetrina_avanzate.conferma_invio: Send {n, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}}?
vetrina_avanzate.descrizione: Sorting, selection, action menus, expandable rows and totals.
vetrina_avanzate.espandibili_spiega: The button on the left opens an area below the row with other components, which see the row as row. Approved orders do not expand (expandIf).
vetrina_avanzate.menu_azioni_spiega: With rowActionsInline: 1 only the first visible action is a button; the others live in the “⋯” menu. Unavailable actions stay visible but disabled.
vetrina_avanzate.ordinamento_pagina: Invoices without server-side paging: sorting happens in the page, on the rows already loaded, with no new requests.
vetrina_avanzate.ordinamento_server: Orders with server-side paging: the service sorts them, reading the order from the screen state. They open sorted by number, descending.
vetrina_avanzate.ordine_in_bozza: Draft order: not yet sent to the customer.
vetrina_avanzate.selezione_spiega: Pick invoices with the check boxes. “Send selected” is enabled only when every selected row is a draft.
vetrina_avanzate.sollecita_aiuto: Only for invoices sent and not yet paid
vetrina_avanzate.totali_spiega: The invoice number is a link (onClick on the column). At the bottom, the totals row: sum of lines and amounts, average VAT rate and number of customers.
vetrina_base.abilitato_dopo_almeno_due_i: Enabled after at least two increments
vetrina_base.conflitto: Conflict (409): the case was already sent
vetrina_base.contatore_alto: The counter is at least 3: going on
vetrina_base.contatore_basso: The counter is below 3: press “Increment the counter” again
vetrina_base.errore_gestito_la_sequenza_: Error handled: the sequence stops here
vetrina_base.i_pulsanti_seguenti_cambian: The buttons below change with the user's permissions: try them with the three profiles in the selector at the top.
vetrina_base.il_contatore_vale_ogni_clic: The counter is {contatore}: each click increases it by one
vetrina_base.nascosto_a_chi_puo_leggere_: Hidden from those who can read IBANs
vetrina_base.ogni_componente_puo_avere_u: Every component can have an optional tooltip (plain text, expressions allowed)
vetrina_base.questa_schermata_mostra_tes: This screen shows text, sections and buttons with the five available actions: set, call, refresh, navigate and toast.
vetrina_base.sequenze_spiegazione: Before and after a call: a named sequence (actions, run step) asks for confirmation, calls the service, reads the response (as) and uses it in the next steps; the if step chooses what to do; onError tells errors apart with error.status.
vetrina_base.visibile_solo_con_il_permes: Visible only with the permission to approve orders
vetrina_campi.consegna_aiuto: Date and time, in local time
vetrina_campi.descrizione: Additional field types, data-source lookups, files, grid, repeatable rows and form dialogs.
vetrina_campi.dialog_spiega: The dialog step opens a window with a form. If saving succeeds the window closes and the sequence goes on (reload and message); Cancel stops it.
vetrina_campi.file_spiega: PDFs or images up to 20 MB. The file goes straight to the service as a real file (multipart), the service answers with an id and the form then saves the id with the name.
vetrina_campi.filtri_nuovi: The new types in the filter bar
vetrina_campi.griglia_spiega: The form has three columns (columns: 3); company name and address take two (span: 2), notes take all of them. On a narrow window the form goes back to one column.
vetrina_campi.inviato: Priority {p}, {u, select, true {express shipping} other {standard shipping}}, notifications on {n} channels
vetrina_campi.lookup_spiega: Type at least two letters of the name or city: the field queries the customer service and suggests the results. The saved value is the customer id; the form starts with a customer that is not among the first results, and the field asks the service for its name.
vetrina_campi.righe_salvate: Order saved with {n, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}
vetrina_campi.righe_spiega: The lines of an order: at least one, at most ten. The item is searched in the catalogue (a lookup in the row); quantity must be above zero, checked row by row when saving.
vetrina_contenitori.aiuto_testo: Row box: title on the left, buttons on the right
vetrina_contenitori.descrizione: Row or column box, column grid and border layout with north, south, west, east and centre regions.
vetrina_contenitori.due_terzi_testo: In a row box, grow shares the free space: here 2 to 1.
vetrina_contenitori.est: East: a fixed-width side column, for notes or summaries.
vetrina_contenitori.nord: North: full width. Below 768px the regions stack.
vetrina_cruscotto.barre_didascalia: Sales and purchase invoices by month, 2026
vetrina_cruscotto.combinato_didascalia: Sales and purchase invoices stacked by month and margin percentage on the right axis, 2026
vetrina_cruscotto.da_incassare_aiuto: Sales invoices sent and not yet paid
vetrina_cruscotto.descrizione: Indicators and charts computed from the service data.
vetrina_cruscotto.grafici_spiega: Drawn in SVG with the theme colours: hover bars, points and slices to read the values. For screen readers every chart is also a table.
vetrina_datatable.archivio_spiega: The same component with 20,000 rows loaded at once: only the current page is drawn, cell texts are computed once and the text filter waits for a short pause between keystrokes.
vetrina_datatable.descrizione: Columns you can filter, sort and group by, with totals per group.
vetrina_datatable.server_spiega: Same interface, but filters, sorting, groups, totals and pages are computed by the service: the browser receives only the page and the groups in view. Opening a group loads its rows page by page.
vetrina_datatable.spiega: Sixty movements loaded once: filter from the icon in the headers, sort with the arrows, pick one or more columns to group by. Each group shows the number of movements and the balance.
vetrina_form.desidero_ricevere_la_newsle: I want to receive the newsletter
vetrina_form.form_di_modifica_dati_dal_s: Edit form: data from the service, fields and actions according to permissions
vetrina_form.le_azioni_di_un_form_ricevo: A form's actions receive the values in 'form'
vetrina_form.tutti_i_tipi_di_campo_i_cam: All field types, required fields, rule-based validation, and fields that appear, lock or disappear according to values and permissions.
vetrina_input.descrizione_iniziale:
## Delivery

1. Pick up at the **warehouse**
2. Check the parcels

> Call before arriving
vetrina_input.formattato_spiegazione:
Texts can use **classic typography**:

- bulleted and numbered lists, also nested
- *italic*, **bold**, ~~strikethrough~~ and `code`
- quotes and [links](https://ng.ant.design/)

No HTML: even text coming from data is safe.
vetrina_input.nome_aiuto: The greeting below updates when you leave the field
vetrina_layout.il_tuo_profilo_non_puo_mo: Your profile cannot edit orders: this message disappears with the permission ordini.ordine.scrivi (try the manager profile).
vetrina_layout.prima_di_un_azione_delica: Before a sensitive action, confirmation is requested. If you press Cancel nothing happens and no error appears.
vetrina_layout.questa_scheda_esiste_solo: This tab exists only for those who can read IBANs: without the permission not even its title appears.
vetrina_layout.sconto_aiuto: Percentage applied to the order total
vetrina_layout.stato_aiuto: Draft, sent to the customer or approved
vetrina_layout.un_messaggio_in_pagina_in: An in-page message informs without interrupting: this one is of type info.
vetrina_tabelle.formati_di_cella_importo: Cell formats: amount, date, yes/no and status label
vetrina_tabelle.le_fatture_inviate_ogni_: Sent invoices: each column chooses how to show the value with the format property. Values stay those of the service, only how they read changes.
vetrina_tabelle.tabella_con_filtri_pagin: Table with filters, server-side paging and row actions
vetrina_tabelle.tabella_semplice_tutte_l: Simple table: all rows in an array, no filters or pages
vetrina_tabelle.una_barra_di_filtri_scri: A filter bar writes into the screen state; the table reloads by itself when the filters change. Rows have actions conditioned by permissions and by the row state.
vetrina_viste.albero_spiega: Expense categories on several levels. Pick a category or search: matches are highlighted. With the keyboard: arrows to move, expand and collapse, Home and End, Enter to pick.
vetrina_viste.calendario_spiega: The month's due dates, coloured by status. When the month changes the calendar writes YYYY-MM to the state and the service loads only that month.
vetrina_viste.descrizione: Step-by-step procedure, tree view and calendar.
